chapter.heading: Psalm 100
His Steadfast Love Endures Forever
A Psalm for giving thanks.
chapter.v:
Make a
joyful noise,
to the LORD, all the earth!

Serve the
LORD with,
gladness! Come into his presence with singing!

Know that
the LORD,,
he is God! It is he who made us, and we are his;(1) we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

Enter his
gates with,
thanksgiving, and his courts with praise! Give thanks to him; bless his name!

For the
LORD is,
good; his steadfast love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations. Footnotes (1) 100:3 Or *and not we ourselves* (ESV)
